description: The November 26 French-Community education strike wave is documented by the CSC page for 18-29 November (BEL2024-11-S014). The CSC press index (S008, body lines 310-314) confirms an advance invitation for teachers to stop work and make noise on 11 December against government measures, but does not describe any public location, an actual gathering, turnout, or whether the action occurred. This remains distinct from the 18 December public-service rally, with different organizers and demands.
required_followup: If needed for month coverage, seek separately permitted contemporary body evidence of whether the 11 December action happened as a public gathering of at least 50 and how it relates to November; do not infer from a work stoppage or advance invitation.
